text: Fort at Sehwan Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Fort at Sehwan Type: Monument - Fort Province: Sindh District: Jamshoro Period: Historic Relative Chronology: 5th - 6th Century CE Description: It is an immense mound of earth measuring roughly 370 x 730 m with surviving height of about 18 m. It is littered with potshards and brick bits and charcoal. The surviving structures depict different constructional periods of the fort and mainly associated to Rai dynasty of Sindh. Latitude: 26.433255556 Longitude: 67.861250000 Ownership: Federal Government Legal Status: Protected by The Antiquity Act 1975 (As amended in 1992) Title of Publication: Inventory of Cultural Property in the Province of Sindh, Pakistan, 2015 Published In: Government of Sindh, Vol 1 Year of Publication: 2015 Bibliography/Reference: Jansen, Michael, Yasmeen Lari Social Media Links Contact Info (+92) 51-9252516 info@doam.gov.pk Sir Syed Memorial Building, 19th Atta-Turk Avenue, Sector G-5/1, Islamabad Quick Links - National Heritage & Culture Division, Government of Pakistan - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, KPK - Directorate of Archaeology Tourism Department, Punjab - Directorate of Archaeology & Museums, Balochistan - Culture, Tourism, Antiquities and Archive Department, Sindh - Tourism, Sports, Culture, Archaeology & Museums Department Gilgit-Baltistan - National Museum of Pakistan, Karachi - Islamabad Museum, Islamabad - UNESCO, Islamabad office, Islamabad - UNESCO World Heritage Centre Department of Archaeology and Museums © 2026.
